cafe.name: Le café : la salle
cafe.alt: Inside the village café, painted in ink and gouache: a tabby cat dancing on a little round table, grandma sunk laughing into a huge pink chair cushion, a go-kart carrying the menu, a green boa holding up a pink lemonade, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret raising a finger to order, Monsieur Verbe in a blue beret gulping a glass of water, Monsieur Verbe in a gold beret sitting down with a hand mirror, the bill curling across the floor, a seagull biting a sandwich that pours out sand, the waiter swerving with two plates of croissants, a baby giraffe sipping orange juice, a poor boar in patched overalls catching a coin in his cup, a ginger cat by a cup of tea on the counter and shelves of treats; a door on the left leads out to the village and the open double door at the back leads to the terrace.

doors.label: La terrasse
doors.hint: Out through the open double door to the terrace

zooms.label: Les étagères
zooms.hint: Look closely at the shelves behind the counter

comptoir.name: Les étagères du comptoir
comptoir.alt: A close-up of the shelves behind the café counter, painted in ink and gouache: a mouse in an apron tossing a cup of coffee into the air, a napkin folded into a swan beside a little bell, a sleepy owl hugging a cup of black coffee, a croissant under a glowing crescent moon, three scoops of ice cream in a tall glass, a kitten asleep in a breakfast bowl and a glass of water shading its eyes.

terrasse.name: La terrasse
terrasse.alt: The café terrace on the village square, painted in ink and gouache: a plant watering itself with a little can, an apple in a pom-pom hat, a stack of pancakes with a pink crepe-paper bow, glasses with crescent-moon lenses, Monsieur Verbe in a gold beret with deer antlers saying something kind under a heart bubble, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret raising his hand under a question-mark bubble, the sun lounging in a deckchair, a beach ball on a string, a red bike speeding off in a puff of dust, a little blue van puffing out a gust of wind, a dapper straw hat with a monocle and moustache, Monsieur Verbe in a purple beret crouching by the fountain pond answering a frog, and a round table with a checked cloth; the purple door on the left leads back inside.

doors.label: La salle
doors.hint: Back inside through the purple door

zooms.label: La table
zooms.hint: Look closely at the terrace table

table.name: La table de la terrasse
table.alt: A close-up of the terrace table on the sunny cobbled square, painted in ink and gouache: the checked tablecloth curled up in a nightcap taking a nap, a salad bowl wearing a lad's flat cap, a pie with a striped straw stuck in it, a kitten holding up the menu, a dove perched on a knife and a cup of hot chocolate with a zap and a music note.
